name: cc-index-server
what_it_holds: Deployable pywb-based CDX Server + replay index server for Common Crawl collections; installable via pip or Docker with `install-collections.sh` to stand up a local CDX Server API (e.g. `/CC-MAIN-2015-06-index?url=...`) against S3-hosted crawl indices.
why_useful: Self-hosted alternative to hitting the public CC CDX API when doing larger point-in-time pulls for airbnb.com or competitor domains across many crawls, avoiding public rate limits during a repeated vintage-register build.
